spec_case: core/compiler.py::_compile_prompt, issue #778's own step 5 (closes issue #507's own item 5)
description: `False` as a `multipleOf` divisor reached through a `$ref` into a key no schema-structure walk recognizes as housing a subschema (`myCustomDefs`) used to skip the metaschema check and reach Python's own runtime `%` arithmetic instead, raising `ZeroDivisionError` from a genuine zero divisor. The new well-formedness check walks every `multipleOf` in the schema unconditionally, so this is now a compile-time refusal before any instance is considered -- a `bool` is never a number under this rule, so `on_error: continue` no longer has anything to absorb.
